notes.title: Clash minor Update
notes.notes:
A new version of the game is live which fixes the following:
- Prevents the duplicate bosses bug (which could happen late in the game).
- Fixed a few rare crashes.

notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE & USER REVIEWS TRAILER
notes.notes:
We have been overwhelmed by the love and support you have given us since we released Clash: Artifacts of Chaos. A simple thanks did not seem nearly enough, so we prepared several surprises for you to enjoy!

NEW GAME PLUS

You asked for it, here it is: the New Game Plus mode. Once the game is finished, you will be able to start again with the upgrades you already got and face tougher, higher-level opponents. This mode also includes exclusive content: a new war paint for Pseudo, new hats for the Boy and a new set of armor for Pseudo to be found in-game. Will you take on the challenge? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847511/9be5d4d63c54a38a89354136a4cb8554aaeb40f8.png

FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS 

This new update incorporates various fixes and improvements to the gameplay experience:

• Quality of life - At night, the location of Dark Bosses (optional end-game challenges) is displayed on the world map 
• Quality of life - Next objectives displayed after beating the Director, as some players told us they were getting lost at this stage
• Options - On first launch, the game now asks the player to set the main parameters: animated or static textures, world loading by streaming or by zones.
• Cinematics - New Boy kidnapping cinematics
• New technology: the advanced NVIDIA Ansel screen capture tool
• Various bug fixes
 
A TRAILER TO THANK ALL OF YOU 

A 95% Steam user score is no small feat and we are deeply grateful to all players that took the time to write a review of Clash. We hope you enjoy this trailer made in fashion of a traditional Accolades Trailer, but with players reviews instead!  

[previewyoutube=WwcAxxb6D5U;full]https://youtu.be/WwcAxxb6D5U[/previewyoutube]

Our special thanks to Ross, SgtLemon1, Throkgaar, Moffein, Dread Guacamole, Eternal Optimist, Magnus, Fox with a cap, ImperialPanda and cronkin tompler who were kind enough to agree on having their review featured in the trailer. We would also like to thank Nogueh, Cahalit, strenkth, and all others that agreed to participate but that we could not integrate in the end: your reviews were a joy to read and we are thankful from the bottom of our heart. 

Our thanks too to all the players of Clash for taking on this incredible journey with Pseudo and the Boy across Zenozoik. We hope you had as much as a blast than us! 

Feel free to follow us on Twitter,  join our Discord or go in the Steam discussions board if you’d like to keep up with all future news and share your thoughts with us – we would love to hear them. 

-  The Clash: Artifacts of Chaos Team

notes.title: Patch Note — v28515
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear fighters!

We've just rolled out a new update, bringing lots of tweaks to exploration, inventory and more...
Without further ado, here's what we changed:

Exploration
 Added additional details to environments to help with navigation.
 Improved world map legibility.
 Progression tab moved to the first slot for easy access.
Levelling
 Enemy health bars change color when they are highly above your level.
 Skill points and experience points notifications added.
 Player stats now include effect of armor in the player level tab.
Inventory
 Inventory tabs can be cycled through.
 Tchaks can now be equipped and unequipped from the inventory slots.
Combat
 Created short tutorial videos in the game over screen to remind players of the core combat mechanics.
 Some special attacks have minor buffs to stun.
 Parry buffed in damage output and slightly larger active frames.
 Hornet Artifact damage scaled for Titan enemies.
Fixes
 Fixed potential crash at startup.
 Fixed non-progression at temple entrance.
 Fixed bug when summoning identical characters with the pact artifact.
 Fixed flasks not producing mixtures when mixing certain ingredients.
 Fixed Dark Enemies not appearing when defeating day time counterpart.
 Fixed boss being able to kill player after being defeated.
 Fixed enemies not having proper level when summoned with Pact Artifact.
 Fixed poison damage animation not showing up on certain enemies.

notes.title: Patch Note — v28402
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

A small patch has just been pushed to Steam to fix a number of issues that were reported to us.
Here's what changed:


 Added confirmation pop-up for assigning skill points and figurines.
 Fixed Boy disappearing after the Palace Cinematic. For corrupt save files visiting the area where Claw Boss is located restores the Boy.
 Fixed Boss not responding after being attacked in night phase.
 Added additional facial animations and lip syncing to Pseudo and other characters.
 Fixed enemy physics bug where they could be pushed at a great distance.
 Fixed first person camera pain animation not showing up.
 Dead enemies no longer collide with invisible walls.
 Fixed water volumes sometimes not working.
 Improved smoke artifact Player vs Enemy (enemies strike each other accidentally)
 Fixed issues with hard lock in first person mode.
 Fixed foot placement "jittering" and collision detection for giant enemies.
 Improved enemy placement for non-targeted enemies in first person mode.
 Titan mammoth has updated hitboxes and less predictable attack patterns
 Credits updated.


We want to thank you for your cooperation and patience, and hope you're having a grand time in the lands of Zenozoik.

notes.title: New Release Date for Clash!
notes.notes:
Greetings Zenozoik inhabitants and other Corwids!

We come to you with a quick news: Clash: Artifacts of Chaos has a new release date! 

Thanks to the community feedback during our two public demos, we were able to pinpoints facets of the game that could be reworked and balanced. With this, we've decided to give ourselves a couple more weeks to polish Clash, in order to give you the best experience possible.

You'll be able to play the game on:
March 9, 2023!

We've also heard a new trailer is coming very soon...

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847511/9c5128fcce7c11e9a639f0e52666f29af3992326.png

Howdy All, 

Thanks for checking out the Clash: Artifacts of Chaos demo as part of the Steam Next Fest. We've been blown away by the support and feedback we've received so far. We're hard at work preparing for the release on February 9th, but we couldn't leave some of the problems with the demo unaddressed.

So we've pushed out a small patch that should fix a few cases of crashing and expand on a few missing options. As always, we remain disposable on our Discord and in the Steam Discussion boards if you have any more feedback. 

Steam Fest Demo Patch Added Invert Y axis to camera options in settings menu.
 Added camera sensitivity options in the settings menu.
 Fixed crash in dialog manager.
 Fixed crash related to challenge totems.
 Fixed stability issue related to achievements.
 Fixed AIs not locating the player if they were too far away.
 Ensured enemies will not retreat when they are engaged in first person.
 AIs not participating in the Ritual can no longer attack the player during it.
 Manual camera lock is enabled on ragdolled enemies.
 Area confinement function uses a collision mesh instead of gradually affecting the player’s velocity.

notes.title: Clash: Artifact of Chaos Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847511/309ea95a785988afc2e49da0eeb323c44c3b73a8.png
During tonight's Nacon Connect, we revealed a new trailer for Clash: Artifacts of Chaos, taking us through one day in the life of Pseudo, a hermit living on the fringes of the colorful world of Zenozoik. 

Pseudo's life will be thrown into turmoil upon his discovery of the Boy, a small creature with mysterious powers that have attracted the attention of Gemini, the Mistress of the Artifacts. This one decision leading to an adventure truly unlike any other. 

The adventure begins on February 9th!
